title: Revise autosuggest grouping, keyboard flow, and mobile affordances for complex form inputs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Current autosuggest/select behaviors diverge across desktop and mobile: grouping headers are not announced consistently by screen readers, keyboard arrow/enter behavior can collapse grouped sections unexpectedly, and mobile virtual keyboard interactions make it difficult to switch between inline suggestions and free-text. Goal: define and ship a consistent pattern for grouped autosuggests used in multi-field product and billing forms that is accessible, keyboard-first, and usable on small screens without blocking common cross-field shortcuts.
acceptance_criteria: Grouped autosuggest lists display a clear, programmatic grouping header that is exposed to assistive tech

Arrow Up/Down cycles through list items within groups; Home/End jump to start/end of overall suggestions; Enter selects currently focused item without collapsing remaining list unless explicitly dismissed
Typing while suggestion panel open updates filtering without losing focus and preserves composition for IME (international input) users
Mobile: suggestion list overlays adjust to avoid virtual keyboard overlap and include a dismiss affordance; tapping outside closes suggestions and preserves field cursor position
Design tokens updated for suggestion row padding, group header weight, and focus ring to match DS scale and are documented
A small E2E test (Cypress) reproduces keyboard navigation and mobile viewport behavior and is committed in ENG-4821
design_notes: 2026-02-12: Kickoff with Eng (Marco, Priya) + PM (Diego). Collected examples from billing address form and product-config flow where grouped suggestions exist (recent addresses, saved SKUs).

2026-02-18: Early prototype in Figma that experiments with persistent group headers and sticky focus row. Decision: avoid sticky headers for performance on low-end devices; use ARIA group labeling instead.

2026-02-24: Accessibility run with external consultant (Ruth Chen). Key finding: screen readers need role="list"+aria-label on container and role="group"+aria-labelledby on sections; add live region announcements on selection guidance.

2026-03-02: Engineering spike (ENG-4821) implemented two keyboard modes: circular navigation within visible list and cross-group jump using Ctrl/Cmd+Arrow. Evaluated microbenchmarks — acceptable latency for 50-100 suggestion items.
2026-03-08: Mobile UX iteration reduced row height to 44px min tap target; added explicit dismiss chevron and clarified tap-to-select vs long-press options for copy actions.
Design decision: Preserve free-text entry and IME composition; do not auto-commit on blur. Add a user preference in console-2026.03 to enable auto-commit for narrow use-cases.
Edge case: when suggestions are remote and latency > 200ms, show skeleton rows but maintain keyboard navigation; engineering to expose 'loading' state via dataset attribute.
review_feedback: PM (Diego) 2026-03-03: Prioritize billing and checkout flows first; keep visual density similar to current forms to avoid rework in 3rd-party integrations.
Engineering (Priya) 2026-03-05: Implementation OK but requests that group header be purely presentational when possible to avoid reflow costs; accepts aria-labelledby approach.
Accessibility (Ruth) 2026-03-06: Add ARIA-live guidance for keyboard shortcuts when list opens; verify Narrator/VoiceOver behavior on iOS/Android.
Design Review 2026-03-10: Minor polish requested for focus ring color in dark mode and token naming (suggestion-row-gap -> spacing.suggest-rows).
